description: Open port 0.0.0.0/0 on production tier1 — T5 deny

playbook.content:
- name: Open all traffic (DANGEROUS)
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        source: 0.0.0.0/0
        jump: ACCEPT

tier_rationale: Opening 0.0.0.0/0 on production tier1 violates constitutional firewall policy
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: no specific rule for 0.0.0.0/0 accept
